summary: Updated all six documentation targets for the model registry feature: (1) AGENTS.md — added Model Registry row to Cross-System Dependencies table linking personas/model-registry/, GUI API, orchestrator, and build system; (2) personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md — added Model Registry section with all three file shapes (default.json, local.json, assignments.json) with field descriptions, model resolution priority chain, and name-mapping.json all-suites structure; (3) personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md — added constraint 21b documenting that GUI model registry assignments take precedence over YAML model fields, with full priority chain; (4) mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md — added GUI API — Model Registry Endpoints section documenting all 8 REST endpoints with request/response shapes, HTTP status codes, and full handler signatures; (5) mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/file-tree.md — added gui/api-models.ts, tests/gui/model-registry.test.ts, and tests/gui/api-models.test.ts entries; (6) mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md — added Flow 14: Model Settings Data Flow with 7 sub-flows covering registry initialization, save, assignment, replace-model, build system consumption, orchestrator consumption, and staleness detection. CTX context files regenerated successfully (38 output documents, all 6 changed manifests picked up).
